points.point: The Vault's automotive radar content is confined to the AREG800A radar echo generator, which is not a VNA
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions AREG800A radar material, but not that automotive radar content is confined to it or that it is not a VNA; also suggests VNA use in AREG800A tests.

points.point: The automotive radar frequency bands documented in the Vault are 24–24.25 GHz, 76–81 GHz and 24–44 GHz (FE44S), given for radar echo generator frontends
points.label: partial
points.why: States 24–24.25 GHz and 76–81 GHz, but omits the 24–44 GHz FE44S frontend band and does not clearly frame all as radar echo generator frontend bands.

points.point: The Vault distinguishes FMCW from non-FMCW radar only in the echo-generation/distance context, not as a VNA measurement requirement
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions FMCW echo generation, but not the FMCW/non-FMCW distinction or that it is only an echo-generation/distance concept, not a VNA requirement.

points.point: The ZNA VNA family page describes coverage from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz with no reference to radar or automotive use cases
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions a 67 GHz base VNA, but not the 10 MHz lower limit and not the absence of radar/automotive use cases on the ZNA page.

points.point: mmWave VNA coverage in the Vault extends to 110 GHz via the ZNA67EXT converter-head system, stated purely as instrument specification
points.label: partial
points.why: States ZNA67EXT coverage to 110 GHz, but does not clearly say this is only an instrument specification with no radar-driven requirement.

points.point: ZNA67EXT dynamic-range data is segmented by band, including the 75 GHz to 80 GHz segment that overlaps the 76–81 GHz radar band, but the Vault never attributes this to radar needs
points.label: partial
points.why: Gives ZNA67EXT dynamic range for 75–80 GHz, but does not state that the Vault never attributes this overlap to radar needs; instead adds a labeled inference about radar-related dynamic range importance.

points.point: ZNB3000 VNA models are documented with frequency upgrade options up to 54.0 GHz, again with no radar or automotive application context
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not mention ZNB3000 frequency upgrade options up to 54.0 GHz or the lack of radar/automotive context.
